display.title: {"text": "Settlements"}
description: Villages, taverns and towns: safe, social, full of supplies. Cartographers sell and stash the maps that point to everything else.
&eSignature rewards:&r Surveyor's Charts (exploration maps to nearby landmarks) in cartographer chests; warp scrolls; food and building blocks.
&eComing back:&r Trading (villagers restock), new villages in new regions. Containers do not refill.
&eFeeds into:&r Building (regional styles), travel (warp scrolls, waystones), clues to landmarks.
&eBrings home:&r Outpost: food, beds and trade lead to your first station; villagers sell the maps that point outward.
&aDo:&r Walk into any settlements structure (early game).
&6You get:&r Surveyor's Charts (exploration maps to nearby landmarks) in cartographer chests.
